verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS design platform like Canva, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention policies, deletion controls, or data-purge options. The audit logs, SCIM provisioning and Admin API user management are adjacent admin features and do not deliver retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
